collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TALL TALES AND SELF-INTEREST (TT-01 to TT-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Boasting, stretched stories, little vanities, wanting the credit, the best seat or the bigger half. Most of it is harmless and funny; kind people can be boastful too. Nobody is exposed for the sake of it, and nobody needs a lesson.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A young villager offers to show an experienced one a better way to clean fish: let them show you, or make it a race.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has just learned a quick way to clean a fish with one long cut, and is very pleased with it. (subject.He/she) spots (friend) cleaning fish by the shore and kindly offers to show (friend.him/her) "a much better way." (friend) has been cleaning fish, perfectly well, for most of (friend.his/her) life.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) puts down (friend.his/her) knife and watches the whole demonstration, nodding. "Very good," (friend.he/she) says, and goes back to doing it (friend.his/her) own way, twice as fast. (subject) watches for a while. "...That's a good way too," (subject.he/she) says. "Is it?" says (friend). "I'll think about it."

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "Ten fish each," says (friend). (subject) is barely on (subject.his/her) fourth when (friend) puts down (friend.his/her) knife. (subject) finishes, looks at the two piles, and says, "Mine are neater." They are, slightly. (friend) agrees generously, and they cook them all for dinner together.
